'''River of Light''' is a [[sword form]]. It is used as a draw-cut, usually ment to unsheath the sword and strike in the same motion. [[Eamon Valda]] used this form against [[Galadedrid Damodred]] during thier [[Trial Beneath the Light]], albeit his sword was already out of its scabbard. Had Galad not quickly countered with [[Rain in High Wind]], Valda would have sheared off one of Galad's arms.{{ref/book|11|p}}

==Parallels==

There is a similar technique in the Japanese sword-art of [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iaido Iaido].
